description: Score sales leads hot/warm/cold with weighted signals and a recommended next action — grounded in real, live verification. Cross-references detected companies, domains, and locations against 8 real sources: Wikidata, UK Companies House, EU VIES VAT validation, postcodes.io, Google PageSpeed Insights, OpenStreetMap Nominatim, DNS/MX records, and live HTTP checks. Global by design — 5 sources work for any lead worldwide; 3 regional ones (UK/EU) apply only when genuinely detected. SPENDS your balance — requires FD_API_KEY.

lead_description.description: Free-text description of the lead: company, contact, context, any details you have.

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to poll (default 60, agent typically takes up to 45s given multi-source enrichment). On timeout, returns task_id to poll later.

name: forcedream_score_lead
title: Score a sales lead
